newsitem.title: UK: Barclays up, confirms Imry sale talks.
newsitem.headline: Barclays up, confirms Imry sale talks.

text.p: Shares in Barclays Plc rose in early trading on Monday after the bank late yesterday confirmed it was in talks to sell property arm Imry Holdings.
Barclays shares were up 5-1/2p at 10.00 stg by 0835 GMT in a firm bank sector, with NatWest up 4p at 695-1/2 and Lloyds TSB up 2-1/2p at 395.
Barclays said it had was in talks with a number of parties including Chelsfield, down 1-1/2p at 270, and has always made it clear it did not intend to be a long-term player in the property market.
The confirmation came after a report in the Sunday Telegraph that Chelsfield may be about to buy Imry fpr ,pre tjam 200 million stg.
